instruction: On page 2, add a note with the text 'Team Members' and make the title bold.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires adding a note with specific text and making title bold on slide 2. Evaluator checks both note text and title bold formatting with partial credit.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete coverage: Both instruction requirements (note text and title bold) are verified with partial credit scoring
Correct getter logic: Extracts note text from slide.notes_slide.notes_text_frame and checks title bold from first run of first paragraph
Correct metric logic: Properly compares result vs expected with exact match for note text and boolean match for title bold
Correct expected parameter handling: Metric directly accesses expected.get('note_text') and expected.get('title_bold'), which is correct for expected.type='rule'
Appropriate postconfig: Saves file with Ctrl+S to ensure changes are persisted before evaluation
Correct expected values: 'Team Members' matches instruction, title_bold=true is semantically correct
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Title bold detection only checks first run (first_para.runs[0].font.bold). If title has mixed formatting, this may miss cases where only part is bold. Consider iterating all runs or checking if ALL runs are bold. However, this is acceptable for most cases where 'make title bold' means formatting entire title.
